CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListAppend

Returns a copy of a list with a new element added at the end. The original list variable is not changed, so assign the result back if you want to keep it.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListAppend(list, value [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to add to. It may be empty.
value
The element to add.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma. The first character is the one placed between the old list and the new element.

Returns

The new list.

Usage

If the list is empty, the result is just the new element, with no leading delimiter, which makes ListAppend perfect for building a list inside a loop. To add an element at the front, use ListPrepend; to put one somewhere in the middle, ListInsertAt.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetDepts" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT Dept_Name FROM Departments
</CFQUERY>
<CFSET DeptList = "">
<CFLOOP QUERY="GetDepts">
  <CFSET DeptList = ListAppend(DeptList, Dept_Name)>
</CFLOOP>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Departments: <B>#DeptList#</B></P>
<P>With a semicolon: <B>#ListAppend("red;green", "blue", ";")#</B></P>
<P>Appended to an empty list: <B>#ListAppend("", "lonely")#</B></P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ListPrepend, ListInsertAt, ListSetAt, ArrayAppend
